title: Master excellence fellowships

compensation.value: CHF 10,000 per semester, up to 4 semesters

about: EPFL Master Excellence Fellowships provide CHF 10,000 per semester for up to four semesters. Applicants tick the fellowship box on the Master application in IS-Academia; only applications paid and validated by 15 December are considered. Current EPFL Master students and Master holders are ineligible.
card_alt: Card for the Master excellence fellowships at EPFL, Switzerland; deadline 15 Dec 2026. The background is the default city skyline photo.
